title: Gulliver of Mars
author: Edwin Lester Arnold
description: "Gulliver of Mars" by Edwin Lester Arnold is a novel first published in 1905.
longDescription: This pioneering work combines fantasy and science fiction, following a military man who travels to Mars by magical means. There he explores strange civilizations and falls in love with a Martian princess.

authorInfo.bio: Edwin Lester Linden Arnold was an English writer. He was the son of journalist and poet Edwin Arnold, and spent his childhood between England and India. His best-known work is Lieut. Gullivar Jones: His Vacation which is one of the earliest examples of the planetary romance sub-genre.
